services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The Discovery Center is the perfect place for your family to celebrate a birthday party, baby shower, family reunion, graduation, and more! Our Museum and Story Garden offer a unique and fun place to host your friends, family, or business colleagues. Please Note: Dates and times are subject to availability. A non-refundable deposit of $100 is required to reserve the Museum or Story Garden. The remaining balance is due one week before the date of the party. If the rental is cancelled with 48 hours notice, a refund will be given in the form of another rental to be used within one year. services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: All camps for 2026 have filled. Registration for next summer will open in March 2027. Discover the magic of play this summer in our 8 week summer camp from June 29 - August 21, 2026 (no camp July 17), offering a variety of engaging programs for ages 3-10. Families will need an active Discovery Center membership in order to register. Full summer registration for our play-based camps opens at 9AM on March 16 2026. Your child will spend sunny days learning and playing in our award-winning Story Garden and taking hikes on the trails within Ross Park.
